items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Lucky Millinder. He played with the (?) band.

ctx.x: November, or something like that. Close to Christmas. We usually went down there every year and stayed three months, down in Ridgeway and Nashville, Tennessee. Red told King, "Man, Hawk is going over in Europe; I see they want him over there." King said, "Man, they got a tenor player in Kansas City, you'all ought to try to get him. He'll fill any place playing." So Red said, "He ain't no Hawk, is he?" King said, "No, he ain't no Hawk, and Hawk ain't he. Ain't no one he either." He said, "You will like him 'cause…
This was after Lester had played briefly with Fletcher Henderson.
